description: Use this when submitting a BitTuition sentiment vote (0-100 or bullish/neutral/bearish) on an allowlisted stock, crypto, or AI subject (no free text; 1 sat/$0.001). Passing terms_version accepts the terms in bittuitive://guide/pricing or GET /api/v1/bittuition/terms. Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

subject.description: Allowlisted ticker, coin, AI model/topic, or AI endpoint.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
